voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json): no new custom voice. A slow, hungry delivery for the draining four-legger.
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi draining disruptor bolt: a deep sucking inhale of energy pulling in, a heavy warbling plasma bolt fired with a hollow vacuum whoop, then a crackling draining hum sliding down in pitch like energy being sucked away, energy weapon, no gunpowder, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Large four-legged alien war machine walking forward: heavy hydraulic legs stepping in steady rhythm, sharp chitinous metallic clicking and clacking at every footfall, deep thuds on dirt, servo whine and pneumatic hiss, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Large four-legged alien war machine destroyed: an energy explosion that implodes with a deep sucking whoomp, crackling electric arcs discharging, a dying synthetic drone winding down in pitch, metal legs buckling and the body crashing to the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
